Physical.name: Power Strike
Physical.description:
Delivers a powerful blow that strikes the target with 30 Power added to P. Atk.
Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Physical.name: Iron Punch
Physical.description:
Attacks an enemy with 34 Power added to P. Atk.
Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Toggle.name: Relax
Toggle.description:
Sits down to rest. HP Regeneration +5.
Consumes 1 MP per second.
Use /stand to stop resting.

Toggle.name: Block Buff
Toggle.description:
Switchable skill.
Your character cannot receive external buff effects.

Equipment.name: Weapon Mastery
Equipment.description: Increases P. Atk. by 8.5% and additionally by 2.

Equipment.name: Armor Mastery
Equipment.description: P. Def. +9 and MP Recovery Bonus by 10%.

Equipment.name: Expertise D
Equipment.description: Increases expertise in using D-grade equipment.

Ability.name: Lucky
Ability.description: At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.

Additional.name: Divine Inspiration
Additional.description: Increases the number of buffs an individual can receive by 1 (+1: 20 => 21).

Special.name: Skill Mastery
Special.description: Depending on user's STR, the re-use time resets or the duration doubles.
